dosage_and_administration: Directions Adults and children 12 years of age and older: use twice daily after brushing your teeth with a toothpaste vigorously swish 10 mL (2 teaspoonfuls) of rinse between your teeth for 1 minute and then spit out do not swallow the rinse do not eat or drink for 30 minutes after rinsing supervise children as necessary until capable of using without supervision Children under 12 years of age: consult a dentist or a doctor
